snippet.title: "Sol Mates" | Game Dev Log
snippet.description:
This is a game development video log for the HVRE version of "Sol Mates: Earthen Star."  A programmer buddy of mine and myself wracked our brains to get certain new features to work that had previously been broken.  We also have a new feature introduced, by the name of "Kitty Kam" with Myst!  Let's see if we actually get anything done!
